description: Annobón reporting concerns July detentions, not a confirmed Q4 gathering — The Oct Guardian report places the grievance letter/protest episode in July and records later detentions. Dec Infobae reports a UN filing and an Annobón delegation at the Nov 27–29 UN Forum on Minorities in Geneva; this is outside Equatorial Guinea. Amnesty’s page is a 2026 retrospective and does not establish a Q4 event.

No Q4 domestic assembly has published or qualitative threshold evidence — Results on a Dec service outage, a hospital review meeting, a holiday event and rights complaints do not establish a public gathering or simultaneous 50 participants.

Open-web regional coverage is uneven — December searches named Malabo, Bata, Annobón, Mongomo, Ebebiyín, Evinayong and Luba and targeted health, education, transport, labor and public services; not a census of all local reporting.
required_followup: Search additional provincial and district outlets/archives.

description: Language gap — Searches were in Spanish, English and French; Fang, Bubi and Fa d’Ambô coverage is absent. Annobón connectivity restrictions also limit independent reporting.

No LexisNexis-equivalent archive or historic baseline — Open web is not equivalent to the manual’s original newspaper search. The available codebook is from 2015 and no official 2024 baseline is supplied.

Lost/partial capture and transformed log view — One duplicate December query was executed before capture; its response is not retained. A separate later execution is captured. Stage search_log.jsonl contains literal backslash+n on some appends; final view will be generated separately using that delimiter, with all original bytes and source hashes preserved.
